look_here_first: Low mat-forming annual with many small leaflets, tiny purplish flowers, and slender pods that curve inward as they dry.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Fabaceae/Astragalus: alternate pinnate leaves, papilionoid pea flowers, and legumes; fruit shape, inflation, hairiness, and curvature are especially useful for species ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: often open grassland, gravel, sand or rocky ground

lookalikes.differences: Small flowers and a low mat-forming annual habit are the first cues. The curved narrow pods help separate it from straight-fruited A. leptocarpus.
